item.title: Plans for luxury estates moving ahead on Alisal
item.description: “Check Haven’s website and you will learn Lusso at Sportorno (sic) Ranch is coming this year with 22 luxury homes, each with a casita, and 11 floor plan options. The website reads that prices will be $5 million to $6 million. Presumably the project will improve Alisal Road around the perimeter, but there’s no bypass road for the golf course in the mix.” The post Plans for luxury estates moving ahead on Alisal appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Dublin teachers union votes ‘no confidence’ in Superintendent Funk’s leadership amid stalled negotiations
item.description: The Dublin Unified School District teachers union recently expressed its near-unanimous disapproval of Superintendent Chris Funk over his alleged neglect of student needs, mismanagement of funds and misleading communication with the public — accusations which the supe has unilaterally denied.
